entities.name: PMID:25429159
observations: Prospective multinational IAEA-sponsored cohort of 327 DLBCL patients treated with R-CHOP; interim PET after 2–3 cycles. Interim PET positivity was associated with poorer 2-year EFS (58% vs 90%; HR 5.31, 95% CI 3.29–8.56), but positive scans split into patients with subsequent PET-negative remission (54%; EFS 86%) and persistent PET positivity (46%; EFS 35%). Authors conclude a single interim PET cannot distinguish chemoresistant lymphoma from eventual complete response and cannot guide risk-adapted therapy.

entities.name: Interim PET limitation
observations: In a prospective international cohort of 327 DLBCL patients, interim PET positivity was prognostic at the group level but did not alone distinguish eventual complete remission from chemoresistant disease; authors said it cannot guide risk-adapted therapy.
